name: Obfuscate — 3 Advanced — Confusion of the Eye

system.description:
This power extends the effect of Mask of a Thousand Faces to another person in a specialized way. While under the influence of this power, the victim perceives one other person of the vampire's choosing as someone else entirely. The victim hears whatever the 'masked' person says but unconsciously explains away any inconsistencies. If the masked person directly tries to persuade the victim of his true identity, the victim proves hard to convince and may grow angry.

You spend a Willpower Trait. Disguising the other person against his will requires success in a Mental Challenge against him. If the masked person tries to convince the victim of the truth, the victim may attempt to throw off the effect with a Static Mental Challenge, aided by any relevant Charisma-based Ability the masked person uses to argue his case.
system.source: Clanbook: Followers of Set, Chapter Two
